mapper.select: select distinct a.autoreview_id, a.autoreview_name, a.autoreview_type, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.create_user from t_cfg_autoreview a left join t_cfg_autoreview_detail b on a.autoreview_id=b.autoreview_id where 1=1 and b.auto_detail_type = #{autoDetailType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and b.ref_id=#{typeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and b.ref_name like concat ('%',#{typeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.autoreview_name like concat('%',#{autoreviewName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and FIND_IN_SET(#{autoreviewType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.autoreview_type) > 0

select a.autoreview_id, a.autoreview_name, a.autoreview_type, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.create_user, b.detail_id, b.auto_detail_type, b.ref_id, b.ref_name from t_cfg_autoreview a left join t_cfg_autoreview_detail b on a.autoreview_id=b.autoreview_id where 1=1 and b.auto_detail_type = #{autoDetailType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and b.ref_id=#{typeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and b.ref_name like concat ('%',#{typeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and FIND_IN_SET(#{autoreviewType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.autoreview_type) > 0
